purpose: Familiar title signpost artwork: four walnut boards, the post, bell, paper tag and parchment sheet

generator.tool: Codex CLI (`codex exec`, image_gen.imagegen built-in tool)

delivery: Original generated dimensions and object pixels are preserved in the PNG masters; only connected exterior cream was normalized to #F4EBD9 before delivery. Runtime WebPs are produced by scripts/optimize-title-assets.ts (see manifest.json): four-corner flood fill, alpha erosion and blur, trimmed object bounds and Lanczos resizing. Masters are never resized or modified by the optimizer.
